entity_type.description: The type of entity to retrieve history for.

entity_id.description: The identifier of the entity to retrieve history for.

from.description: Start of the time range, in date-math syntax. Defaults to 90 days ago.

to.description: End of the time range, in date-math syntax. Defaults to now.

score_type.description: Filter entries by the type of score recorded (`base`, `propagated`, or `resolution`).

page_size.description: Maximum number of history entries to return per request.
